narr-intro.text: The dragon footprints led Princess Kathleen and Pip to a sparkling river. Three little frogs sat on the lily pads, singing.
narr-intro.speaker: Narrator

fairy-intro.text: Listen, Kathleen! The frogs are singing a song. Can you sing it back?
fairy-intro.speaker: Pip

fairy-howto.text: Watch the flowers light up, then tap them in the same order!
fairy-howto.speaker: Pip

fairy-tryagain.text: Oops! Let's listen one more time.
fairy-tryagain.speaker: Pip

fairy-gem.text: Look! Something purple is floating in the water. Tap it, Kathleen!
fairy-gem.speaker: Pip

fairy-gem-got.text: A Purple Dragon Gem! Just like the little dragon's purple scales. Let's keep it safe!
fairy-gem-got.speaker: Pip

narr-complete.text: The frogs croaked goodbye. Far away, in the Twinkle Forest, tiny lights began to glow... To be continued!
narr-complete.speaker: Narrator
